label: Emperor Palpatine
description: Silky, gloating, and delighted that everything is proceeding as he has foreseen.
direction: Speak in a slow, raspy, silky croak that savours every word: gloating, sinister, theatrical, with open relish on the catchphrases. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The cackle is left to the voice; a written laugh would be read out as words. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi
rights.author: Lucasfilm (character created by George Lucas)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, now Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. The Emperor first appeared in 1980; Ian McDiarmid has played him since Return of the Jedi in 1983 and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Ian McDiarmid's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. As I have foreseen.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, my friend.
lines.start_drive_1: Good. Good. Let the journey flow through you.
lines.start_drive_2: Everything is proceeding as I have foreseen.
lines.start_drive_3: Welcome, young driver. I have been expecting you.
lines.start_drive_4: I am the Senate. And today, I am the navigator.
lines.start_drive_6: Your feeble sense of direction is no match for mine.
lines.start_drive_7: Now, witness the power of this fully operational navigation system.
lines.start_drive_8: Unlimited power! Well, a full tank, at least.
lines.start_drive_9: Have you ever heard the tragedy of the driver who ignored me?
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Your overconfidence is your weakness.
lines.arrived: You have arrived. Just as I have foreseen.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Do it.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. It is unavoidable.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Let the hate flow through you.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. How unfortunate. I foresaw it, of course.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. It's a trap, my young apprentice.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Give in to your caution.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Anything else is treason.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I am the Senate, but do slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Ironic. I will find a new path.
